'''IT-O''', also known as '''Eyetee-Oh''', was an [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O interrogation droid]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The droid was employed as an interrogator for [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]<ref name="CCG-ITO" /> held aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> IT-O was equipped with probes and needles,<ref name="CCG-ITO" /> including a [[hypo]] that administered the [[Truth serum/Legends|truth serum]] [[Bavo Six]].<ref name="CCG-Hypo">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Hypo}}</ref> The droid would perform "surgery" on prisoners, and its [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] were capable of analyzing and determining the pain threshold of its subject and the truthfulness of their answers.<ref name="CCG-ITO" /> IT-O was responsible for the interrogation of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] after her capture from the ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]]''.<ref name="ANH" />
